title:
Third defibrillator- 

We have now completed our fundraiser and we have installed a defibrillator at our third building. Why was it important to us to achieve this? 

The survival rate for cardiac arrest with defibrillation depends on how quickly defibrillation occurs after collapse: 
 
Within 3–5 minutes: Survival rates can be as high as 50–70% 
 
Each minute of delay: The probability of survival decreases by 10% 
 
No defibrillation: Survival rates are around 7% 

https://www.bhf.org.uk/how-you-can-help/how-to-save-a-life/defibrillators
